visualEvidence.method: Opened both real first-screen PNGs with the view tool; also opened desktop-full.png and mobile-full.png.
visualEvidence.desktop: Strong 100px headline hierarchy and restrained liquid shader. Balanced 60px margins, solution underline, project seal and legible footer metadata. Full-page review found coherent light/dark transitions, consistent section spacing, clear stacked project imagery and unclipped grids.
visualEvidence.mobile: 390px viewport has consistent 24px gutters, readable 42px headline, in-bounds solution extension and separated seal/scroll cues. Full-page review confirmed single-column services, projects, team and plans, proportionate masonry and no clipped content.
visualEvidence.refinements: Replaced initially static heavy Google font responses with genuine variable Inter/Outfit fonts; added explicit dialog Tab containment. Final source passed the complete browser suite.
